'''Enni Anni''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] who was a member of the [[Music/Legends|band]] [[Distraction]]. He played the [[Kloo horn/Legends|Kloo horn]]. He fidgeted a lot and liked breaking things. He also encouraged violence during Distraction concerts. He and the band toured the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], and once performed aboard the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], ''[[Sleemo Poya Jeedai]]''.
